findings.issue: Documented command input with {path} placeholder can never run (reproduced): extract_input passes source_path None; InputSpec::Command has no path field; extraction.md example fails CONFIG_INVALID.

git '<rev>:<path>' resolves against toplevel, not -C dir; when RepoRoot is a subdirectory (sc-ai --repo-root sub, sc-jev-py cwd default) --rev reads a different file than WORKTREE (reproduced). Fix: '{rev}:./{relative}' or canonicalize RepoRoot to toplevel.
Sequential placeholder substitution re-expands {other_input} found inside extracted text (reproduced; Python f-strings). Fix: single-pass split-and-rebuild.
--rev requires check.toml to exist in the worktree (canonicalize before load_check_at) and follows worktree symlinks (reproduced). Fix: lexical normalisation.
Git option injection via --rev=--output=FILE (no --end-of-options; = form bypasses leading-dash check) — reproduced: git opens the file for writing. Fix: --end-of-options + reject leading '-'.
WORKTREE reads follow symlinks out of the repo root (lexical validation only); committed symlink pulls arbitrary local files into LLM payload. Fix: canonicalize + prefix check or refuse symlinks.
Relative RepoRoot makes {repo_root} substitute 'sub' while child cwd is already sub -> sub/sub. Fix: absolutize RepoRoot at construction.
read_git_show maps every git failure to INPUT_MISSING and accepts tree objects (git show <rev>:<dir> exits 0). Fix: cat-file -t blob check; classify stderr.
Equal-input leak always false / equal always true (tautological); REQ-SAG-0602 attestation carries no information.
Absolute source path through a symlink (/tmp on macOS) rejected as outside repo because strip_prefix compares raw arg vs resolved toplevel (reproduced). Fix: canonicalize arg first.
--request-json state validation accepts duplicate/contradictory answers that the check.toml path rejects. Fix: one shared validator.
Doc says InputInvalid for non-JSON subjects bytes; code returns ExtractionInvalid.

REQ-SAG-0102 cross-impl fixture covers none of the escaping cases where serde_json and json.dumps could diverge (\n, \t, quotes, C0 controls, U+2028, non-BMP, non-ASCII key order). Extend fixture and regenerate reference.
Session-log flush failure after a successful live run -> exit 2 and discards session_id/outcomes though log is documented best-effort.
Session RMW protected only by in-process Mutex; fixed tmp name per session id so concurrent ask processes lose updates / ENOENT on rename. Fix: unique tmp + advisory lock or document single-writer.
ask --text cannot start with '-' in either form.
